about.title: Your best travel experience starts here
about.intro: At {{name}}, we’re passionate about turning your travel dreams into unforgettable experiences. Since our founding in 2015, we’ve been committed to delivering top-quality tourism services with a personal touch.
about.body:
Based in the beautiful Dominican Republic, we specialize in **excursions, transfers, hotels, flights and cruises**, offering tailored attention to ensure a smooth and enjoyable journey from start to finish.

Our team stands out for its attention to detail, outstanding customer service and carefully curated experiences — always at the best market prices. Whether you’re seeking hidden gems or travelling in comfort, {{name}} is your trusted partner for the most memorable adventures.
about.vision: To provide unforgettable travel experiences in the Dominican Republic through personalized, reliable and high-quality service that exceeds every traveller’s expectations, while promoting respect for our culture and natural environment.
about.mission: To become the leading inbound tourism company in the Dominican Republic, recognized for service excellence, continuous innovation and a strong commitment to sustainability — the preferred choice for travellers from around the world.

promises.title: Lots of choices
promises.text: Island days, jungle trails, city history and open-sea adventures — dozens of excursions across the country.

promises.title: Easy booking
promises.text: No complicated tickets: choose your day, tap a few times, or simply message us on WhatsApp.

promises.title: Accommodation
promises.text: Hotels and resorts at the best price through our partner Exclusive Hotel Punta Cana.

promises.title: Best tour guides
promises.text: Certified, bilingual guides ready to look after you anywhere you go.

faq.q: What’s included in the price of each tour?
faq.a: Our tours usually include transportation, bilingual guides, entrance fees, and sometimes drinks or lunch — depending on the excursion. Each activity lists exactly what’s included.

faq.q: How do I book a tour?
faq.a: Book directly on our website, send us a message on WhatsApp, or email {{email}}. We’ll confirm your reservation and send you all the details.
Yes! We offer hotel pickup and drop-off at most Punta Cana resorts and surrounding areas. Just tell us where you’re staying when you book.

faq.q: What happens if it rains on the day of the excursion?
faq.a: In most cases tours continue in light rain. If the weather is unsafe, we’ll reschedule or give you a full refund — your safety is our priority.

faq.q: Can I cancel or reschedule my booking?
faq.a: Yes, with advance notice: cancellations at least 48 hours before the tour are refunded in full, and changes are free up to 48 hours before, subject to availability.

faq.q: Are the excursions suitable for kids or seniors?
faq.a: Absolutely! Many of our tours are family-friendly and safe for all ages. If you’re not sure, we’ll happily recommend the best options for your group.

contact.intro: Ready for your next Caribbean adventure? Whether you have questions about tours, transfers, hotels or even cruises — just reach out. At {{name}} we treat every traveller like family.

policies.title: Privacy Policy
policies.body:
At **{{brand}}**, we are committed to protecting the privacy and confidentiality of your personal information. This Privacy Policy outlines how we collect, use, and safeguard your data when you use our website and services. By using our website, you agree to the practices described in this policy.

### 1. Information We Collect

**1.1. Personal Information:**
We may collect personal information such as your name, email address, phone number, payment details, and any other information you provide during bookings or inquiries.

**1.2. Non-Personal Information:**
We may also collect non-personal information, such as browser type, device information, IP address, and browsing behavior, to improve our services.

### 2. How We Use Your Information

2.1. To process and manage your bookings, inquiries, and transactions.
2.2. To provide customer support and respond to your questions.
2.3. To improve our website, services, and customer experience.
2.4. To send promotional emails and updates about our services, subject to your consent.
2.5. To comply with legal obligations and prevent fraudulent activities.

### 3. Sharing Your Information

3.1. We do not sell or rent your personal information to third parties.
3.2. We may share your information with trusted third-party service providers, such as payment processors or tour operators, to fulfill your bookings or transactions.
3.3. We may disclose your information to comply with legal obligations, enforce our terms, or protect our rights and safety.

### 4. Cookies and Tracking Technologies

4.1. Our website uses cookies to enhance your browsing experience and analyze website traffic.
4.2. Cookies are small text files stored on your device that help us remember your preferences and provide personalized content.
4.3. You can manage your cookie preferences through your browser settings.

### 5. Data Security

5.1. We implement reasonable security measures to protect your personal information from unauthorized access, loss, or misuse.
5.2. While we strive to safeguard your data, no method of transmission over the Internet is completely secure. Therefore, we cannot guarantee absolute security.

### 6. Your Rights

6.1. You have the right to access, update, or delete your personal information stored with us.
6.2. You can opt out of receiving promotional communications by clicking the “unsubscribe” link in our emails or contacting us directly.
6.3. If you wish to exercise your rights, please email us at:
📧 **{{email}}**

### 7. Third-Party Links

7.1. Our website may contain links to third-party websites. We are not responsible for the privacy practices or content of those sites.
7.2. We encourage you to review the privacy policies of any third-party websites you visit.

### 8. Changes to This Privacy Policy

8.1. We reserve the right to update this Privacy Policy at any time. Changes will be posted on this page with the updated effective date.
8.2. Continued use of our website after such changes indicates your acceptance of the revised policy.

### 9. Contact Us

If you have any questions or concerns about this Privacy Policy or how your information is handled, please contact us:

📧 **Email:** {{email}}
📞 **Phone:** +1 (809) 982-6438

policies.title: Cancellation and Refund Policy
policies.body:
At **{{brand}}**, we strive to provide the best possible experience for our customers. We understand that plans can change, so we have outlined our cancellation and refund policy below to ensure clarity and transparency.

### 1. Cancellation Policy

**1.1. Excursions and Transfers:**

- Cancellations made **at least 48 hours prior** to the scheduled date will receive a **full refund**.
- Cancellations made **less than 48 hours** prior to the scheduled date are **non-refundable**.

**1.2. Hotel Bookings:**

- Cancellation policies for hotels depend on the specific terms of each hotel and will be communicated at the time of booking.
- Non-refundable bookings or those canceled within the hotel’s stated time frame will not be eligible for a refund.

**1.3. Flights and Cruises:**

- Flight and cruise cancellations are subject to the policies of the respective airlines or cruise lines.
- Refund eligibility will depend on the ticket type and the terms provided at booking.

### 2. Refund Policy

**2.1. Refund Eligibility:**

- Refunds will be processed only for eligible cancellations as per the conditions stated above.
- Refunds may also be issued if the service is canceled by **{{brand}}** due to unforeseen circumstances, such as weather conditions or operational issues.

**2.2. Processing Time:**

- Refund requests will be processed within **7–10 business days** from the date of approval.
- Refunds will be credited to the original payment method used during booking.

**2.3. Non-Refundable Services:**

- Certain discounted or promotional services may be marked as non-refundable. These terms will be clearly communicated at the time of purchase.

### 3. Changes to Bookings

**3.1. Excursions and Transfers:**

- Date or time changes are allowed up to **48 hours prior** to the service at no additional charge, subject to availability.
- Changes requested less than 48 hours before the service may not be accommodated.

**3.2. Hotels, Flights, and Cruises:**

- Changes are subject to the policies of the respective service provider and may involve additional fees.

### 4. No-Shows

**4.1.** If you fail to show up at the designated time and location for your excursion, transfer, or other booked services, **no refunds** will be issued.

### 5. Force Majeure

**5.1.** {{brand}} is not responsible for cancellations or interruptions caused by events beyond our control, including but not limited to natural disasters, strikes, or government restrictions.

### 6. Contact Us

For cancellation or refund requests, please contact us:

📧 **Email:** {{email}}
📞 **Phone:** +1 (809) 982-6438

policies.title: Cookie Policy
policies.body:
At **{{brand}}**, we use cookies and similar technologies to improve your experience on our website, analyze traffic, and personalize content. This Cookie Policy explains what cookies are, how we use them, and your options regarding their use.

### 1. What Are Cookies?

1.1. Cookies are small text files stored on your device when you visit a website.
1.2. They help the website recognize your device and remember information about your visit, such as preferences and actions.
1.3. Cookies do not typically contain personal information but may link to data you provide to us.

### 2. Types of Cookies We Use

**2.1. Essential Cookies:**
Necessary for the proper functioning of the website. They enable features like secure login and booking processes.

**2.2. Performance Cookies:**
Collect anonymous information about how visitors use our website, such as pages visited and time spent, to improve functionality and user experience.

**2.3. Functional Cookies:**
Allow us to remember your preferences, such as language or region settings, to provide a more personalized experience.

**2.4. Marketing Cookies:**
Track your browsing activity and may be used to display targeted advertisements based on your interests.

### 3. How We Use Cookies

3.1. To ensure the website functions correctly.
3.2. To understand how users interact with our website and improve its design and content.
3.3. To provide personalized content and recommendations.
3.4. To analyze the effectiveness of our marketing campaigns.

### 4. Third-Party Cookies

4.1. We may use third-party cookies, such as those from analytics providers (e.g., Google Analytics) or social media platforms, to understand user behavior and improve our services.
4.2. These cookies are managed by third parties and are subject to their privacy policies.

### 5. Managing Cookies

5.1. You can manage your cookie preferences through your browser settings. Most browsers allow you to:

- View and delete existing cookies.
- Block cookies from specific websites.
- Disable all cookies entirely.

5.2. Please note that disabling cookies may affect the functionality of our website and limit some features.

### 6. Updates to This Cookie Policy

6.1. We may update this Cookie Policy from time to time to reflect changes in technology or legal requirements.
6.2. Any updates will be posted on this page with the revised effective date.

### 7. Contact Us

If you have any questions or concerns about our use of cookies, please contact us:

📧 **Email:** {{email}}
📞 **Phone:** +1 (809) 982-6438
